label: Увидеть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for увидеть (to see, catch sight of).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. 'Увижу' is the simple future of perfective увидеть, with the д → ж mutation of the first person. As a perfective it needs no auxiliary and marks a single completed sighting.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Увидишь' keeps the -ишь ending without mutation, since the д → ж change appears only in the first person. 'Скоро' frames the completed event ahead.

missions.phrase: Она увидит море в первый раз.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Увидит' is the simple future of увидеть and points to one finished moment of seeing. Contrast it with the imperfective partner видеть, which describes ongoing or repeated seeing.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Увидим' takes the -им ending and promises a single completed outcome. 'Уже завтра' anchors the achievement in the near future.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Увидите' is the respectful -ите future form. 'Своими глазами' is a fixed instrumental phrase meaning with your own eyes.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Увидел' is the masculine past with the -л suffix, marking a completed glimpse. 'Странный сон' is the accusative object of a one-time event.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Увидела' adds the feminine -ла ending. Two perfectives in a row mark a quick sequence of completed actions.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Увидели' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'После дождя' sets the moment of the single completed sighting.

missions.phrase: Я очень хочу увидеть тебя снова.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective infinitive. 'Увидеть' stays in the infinitive after the modal 'хочу'. The perfective stresses one wished-for reunion rather than habitual seeing, the role of imperfective видеть.

Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Увидь' is the informal command of увидеть, urging the listener to catch sight of something at once. It pairs naturally with the perfective partner of видеть.
